title: One model for a whole design space (Large Physics Model)
description: A single trained model covers the ellipse family of potential flow: held-out Cp on unseen geometries, an ensemble spread per prediction and an out-of-distribution flag on geometries outside the family, all against the exact Milne-Thomson answer.
methods: Large Physics Model (geometry code, multi-scale neighbourhoods, ensemble heads, OOD)

metrics.name: train_rel_l2_mean
metrics.how: relative L2 of Cp over the training designs

metrics.name: heldout_rel_l2_mean
metrics.how: relative L2 of Cp on designs drawn with a different seed, exact analytic reference

metrics.name: ensemble_spread_mean
metrics.how: mean of the ensemble std over the held-out predictions

metrics.name: constant_field_baseline_rel_l2
metrics.how: relative L2 of predicting the training-average Cp at every point, same held-out designs

metrics.name: train_seconds
metrics.how: wall time of fit() on this machine

metrics.name: seconds_per_epoch
metrics.how: wall time divided by the epochs run

metrics.name: epochs_to_final_loss
metrics.how: MSE of the bagged training loss

checks.name: heldout_matches_the_exact_answer
checks.label: held-out Cp within 10% of the Milne-Thomson potential-flow answer

checks.name: beats_the_constant_field
checks.label: held-out error 0.067 against 0.385 for the constant-field baseline

checks.name: ood_square
checks.label: square flagged as outside the trained family (score 5.89)

checks.name: ood_circle_r3
checks.label: circle_r3 flagged as outside the trained family (score 57.28)

checks.name: ood_thin_ellipse_a025
checks.label: thin_ellipse_a025 flagged as outside the trained family (score 4.26)

references: Milne-Thomson, Theoretical Hydrodynamics, 5th ed. (1968), §9.61: surface speed of potential flow past an ellipse
Wu et al., Transolver, ICML 2024, arXiv:2402.02366 (geometry-aware attention over the surface points)
